creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The bridge still names a pane by the daemon's id in the text it prints into the pane: "muster-bridge: pane w5:p1 closed: ..." and "could not attach to pane w5:p1". Nobody can pass `w5:p1` to `muster`, which takes Muster's own pane names.

Since `c140415` the app hands the bridge Muster's name as `--pane-name`, and the takeover text already uses it for `muster pane reattach --pane <name>`. The other lines in `crates/muster-bridge/src/main.rs` could use the same argument, falling back to the daemon id when it is absent (a bridge run by hand).

Minor. Found by slot 1 of the 2026-09-12 round.
title: The bridge names a pane by the daemon's id, which muster cannot take
